english.title: Disclose business information obtained under the Telecommunications Act 1984
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information with respect to a business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..) which had been obtained under or by virtue of the provisions of the Telecommunications Act 1984 and related to

(A)_[the private affairs of an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY INDIVIDUAL..), during the lifetime of that individual]_
(B)_[a business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..), for so long as that business continued to be carried on]_
(C)_[that business for so long as that business continued to be carried on]_

without the consent of

(D)_[that individual]_
(E)_[the person for the time being carrying on that business]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 101(1) and (5) of the Telecommunications Act 1984.

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Section 101(2) sets out some exceptions to the disclosure rule.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
